value: Access to Akama is followed by a test of loyalty. The quest directs the seeker against Ashtongue whom Akama marks as a threat to his cover. This violence belongs to a controlled performance within the chain: his Deathsworn remain the trusted circle while his public service to Illidan is maintained. The objective is not evidence of a massacre of the tribe or that Akama has abandoned his people.
